title: Hold Service State
description: Keeps the latest value one side of a pipeline produced, and replays it to the other side. (Runtimes: browser, node, python, cpp; IDs: hookup.to/service/hold, hold)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

slot.description: The cell to hold in. Set, op says which end this Hold is and the value is not inspected.

op.description: Which end. Only read with a slot.

value.description: **Browser only.** On a writing end (slot + op: "write"), written into the slot when configured, as though it had arrived as input. The board keeps it, so the slot holds it again after a reload. How a board sets a value nothing in its pipelines produces — a tempo, a limit — and how a facade control changes it. Ignored on a reading end.

action.description: Forgets the held value and resets the counts.
